instructions: Template for bulk-generating FAQ content for injector.world. Read the fields and referenceData sections below, then fill the faqs array with your generated FAQ objects (see the exact shape in fields). Save as .json and upload it on the FAQs admin page. Uploaded FAQs are staged as pending review and only go live after an admin approves them. This file intentionally has no example rows, only schema and reference data.

question.description: The FAQ question, plain text, no markdown.

answer.description: 40 to 80 words ideal, plain text, no markdown. Calm, factual, expert tone. No fear-based language, no hype, no em dashes.

answerDetail.description: Optional 90 to 140 word long-form detail, plain text, no markdown. Shown below the short answer on the page. Included alongside the short answer in the FAQPage acceptedAnswer.text (short + detail).

scope.description: What this FAQ is about. Used only to pick a category automatically when categorySlug is empty. See referenceData.scopeRules.

categorySlug.description: The url of an existing FAQ category, e.g. 'botox' for /faq/botox. This is the page the FAQ lives on. Leave blank and it is picked automatically: place first (locationSlug), then serviceSlug, then brandSlug, then guideSlug, else General. Categories are created on the FAQs admin screen, Categories tab.

section.description: Group on the category page: basics (what it is, how it works), treatment (appointment, pain, aftercare, recovery, dosing), results (how long it lasts, what it looks like), safety (risks, side effects), cost. Leave blank and it is guessed from the question.

showInPreview.description: false keeps the FAQ on its category page only, never in the short preview on treatment, brand, guide or place pages.

guideSlug.description: The slug of an existing guide from referenceData.validGuideSlugs. Required when scope is 'guide' (topics with no treatment or brand page, e.g. jowls).

serviceSlug.description: The exact slug of an existing service from referenceData.validServices, for example 'lip-filler'. Required when scope is 'service'. Optional on a 'location' FAQ to narrow it to one treatment within that place.

brandSlug.description: The exact slug of an existing brand from referenceData.validBrands, for example 'botox'. Required when scope is 'brand'. Optional on a 'location' FAQ to narrow it to one brand within that place.

locationSlug.description: The exact slug of an existing state or metro from referenceData.validLocations, for example 'texas' (a whole state) or 'houston-tx' (one metro). Required when scope is 'location'. The FAQ shows only on that exact state or city page. A city page never borrows its state's FAQs, so write city FAQs for the city.

clinicType.description: Required when scope is 'clinic-type'. Matches clinics by the kind of practice they are, not a location.

relatedGuideSlug.description: The slug of an existing guide from referenceData.validGuideSlugs, for example 'botox-cost'. Used by the AI assistant to suggest a guide link in chat answers, AND now rendered on-page as a visible 'Read the full guide' link beneath the FAQ. Leave blank if not applicable.

offLabel.description: Set true if this FAQ discusses an off-label use of a treatment or product. Renders an inline notice on the page.

safetyFlag.description: Flags medical safety context that must render as an inline notice. Use 'serious-risk' for serious-risk FAQs, 'non-fda-approved' for non-FDA-approved products, 'none' (or omit) otherwise.

sortRank.description: Lower numbers show first within the same scope/tag group.

stableId.pattern: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only, e.g. botox-cost-per-unit
stableId.description: A short unique id for this FAQ. Leave blank and one is generated automatically from the question. Re-uploading with the same stableId later updates that FAQ instead of creating a duplicate, so set this explicitly if you plan to revise this batch later. Re-uploading always resets reviewStatus to pending, even if the FAQ was previously approved.

scopeRules.homepage: About injector.world itself. Goes to the General category and is used by the AI assistant.
scopeRules.service: About one treatment. Requires serviceSlug. Lands in that treatment's category, previewed on /services/<treatment>.
scopeRules.brand: About one brand. Requires brandSlug. Lands in that brand's category, previewed on /brands/<brand>.
scopeRules.guide: About a topic with no treatment or brand page. Requires guideSlug. Lands in a topic category previewed on that guide.
scopeRules.location: About one place. Requires locationSlug. Shows on /clinics/<state> or /clinics/<state>/<city>. Add serviceSlug or brandSlug and it also shows on that treatment or brand page for the same place.
scopeRules.clinic-type: Not shown on clinic pages any more (they build their own clinic-specific FAQs). Lands in General unless categorySlug is set.

referenceData.validLocationsNote: Any US state or metro already on the site can be used. States use the plain state slug, e.g. 'texas', 'california', 'new-york'. Metros append the state code, e.g. 'houston-tx', 'miami-fl'. The top 20 launch metros: new-york-ny, los-angeles-ca, miami-fl, chicago-il, houston-tx, dallas-tx, atlanta-ga, phoenix-az, seattle-wa, boston-ma, washington-dc, san-francisco-ca, denver-co, austin-tx, san-diego-ca, philadelphia-pa, nashville-tn, charlotte-nc, las-vegas-nv, portland-or.
